recentItems.description:
Who are the biggest cheapskates on the show? We call out Straight Nate and Scotty B for their questionable spending habits, debate whether electric cars are actually worth it, and hear from a listener with a serious fear of fish. Plus, we talk about Gen Z bringing back everything from vinyl and disposable cameras to libraries, and break down what makes the “perfect” relationship.
